repeats.line: "Yeah? What's up?"

repeats.name: Kate
repeats.line: "...Fine. This had better be worth it."

repeats.name: Kate
repeats.line: "Bakhyt was a dockworker, before. You can still see it — the way he handles things."

repeats.name: Valeria
repeats.line: "Hm. Never mind — go on."

repeats.name: Austin
repeats.line: "Forget I said anything. What did you want? Don't waste it."

repeats.name: Majda

repeats.name: Rosa
repeats.line: "I used to think worse of Valeria. The scattering has a way of... editing people. Mostly for the better. Mostly."

repeats.name: Valeria
repeats.line: "Like I said — Still on the others."

repeats.name: Rosa
repeats.line: "Jovan is back. Walked in like they'd never left."

repeats.name: Rosa
repeats.line: "...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.

repeats.name: Kate
repeats.line: You show them Jewelweed — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."

repeats.name: Kate
repeats.line: "It's just — Still on the others. That's still where we are."

repeats.name: Rosa
repeats.line: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."
